class.name: IfcRelAssignsToResource
class.brief_description: The objectified relationship IfcRelAssignsToResource handles the assignment of objects (as subtypes of IfcObject ), acting as a resource usage or consumption, to a resource (as subtypes of IfcResource ). EXAMPLE The assignment of a resource usage to a construction resource is an application of this generic relationship. It could be an actor, as person or organization assigned to a labor resource,

members.member: Reference to the resource to which the objects are assigned to. IFC2x4 CHANGE Datatype expanded to include IfcResource and IfcTypeResource .
